audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Algorithm5.1 does not produce feasible probabilities; Algorithm5.2 omits complementary carry assignment; Pinned implementation can exhaust residual sampling budget
limitations: Algorithm5.1 does not produce feasible probabilities — Counterevidence: The p. 14 prose describes a recursive construction, and the optimal q* characterization on p. 17 requires thresholding until the condition fails. These identify the intended correction.

Algorithm5.1 does not produce feasible probabilities — Counterevidence: The pinned rsri.py lines 33–36 returns an unchanged copy whenever nnz(v)<=m. Lines 42–48 repeatedly recompute the preservation threshold, so it does not have the printed one-pass omission.
Algorithm5.1 does not produce feasible probabilities — Scope limit: Specific acquired version and stated location only; not a general rejection of the intended RSRI convergence theory.
Algorithm5.2 omits complementary carry assignment — Counterevidence: The two-outcome pivotal calculation in PIV-C3 shows the intended complementary assignment.

Algorithm5.2 omits complementary carry assignment — Counterevidence: The retained code lines 76–80 explicitly selects the left and updates the survivor to the right in one branch, and selects the right while retaining the left in the other. Lines 83–91 handle the final residual selection.

Algorithm5.2 omits complementary carry assignment — Counterevidence: In an exact-arithmetic reading, this retained control flow gives the corrected three-set distribution for the test probabilities. No author-code execution or claim of general floating-point correctness is made.
Algorithm5.2 omits complementary carry assignment — Scope limit: Specific acquired version and stated location only; not a general rejection of the intended RSRI convergence theory.
Pinned implementation can exhaust residual sampling budget — Scope limit: Specific acquired version and stated location only; not a general rejection of the intended RSRI convergence theory.

Auxiliary normalization and local statement corrections — Counterevidence: The proof of Theorem 5.1 explicitly starts with ||u||_infinity<=1 and explicitly uses it in the final variance bound. The main theorem's triple norm already incorporates this normalization.

Auxiliary normalization and local statement corrections — Counterevidence: The monotonicity needed for the tail bound follows directly from a>=S/k, as shown in PIV-C6. Therefore this local algebra display does not refute Proposition 5.2.
Auxiliary normalization and local statement corrections — Scope limit: Specific acquired version and stated location only; not a general rejection of the intended RSRI convergence theory.
Wrong phase index in intermediate variance identity — Scope limit: Specific acquired version and stated location only; not a general rejection of the intended RSRI convergence theory.
PageRank constant needs direct martingale specialization — Counterevidence: Direct averaged solution coefficient Bs has1norm<=1/(1-alpha), giving8Q/[(1-alpha)^2t], stronger than printed16
PageRank constant needs direct martingale specialization — Scope limit: Specific acquired version and stated location only; not a general rejection of the intended RSRI convergence theory.
